rules.rule: Check mode never changes code unless asked
must: Do not change code unless asked

rules.rule: Review judges by reading; no gofmt/vet/lint/test
must: do not run gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint, or go test
a shell width measure

rules.rule: Style dimension delegated to go:style, not re-derived
must: do not re-derive style rules here
report offenses only

rules.rule: plan_first proposes then stops; broad targets default to plan-first
must: propose the budget and the package list, then stop for the user's answer
Default to plan-first: if the target is broad

rules.rule: State resolved target; empty diff falls back to the branch diff against base
must: State the resolved target and the exact package/file set before reviewing
diff it against the base branch

rules.rule: Fan-out workers get no cap share; cap applied once at the merge
must: Workers get no share of the cap
the cap is applied once at the merge

rules.rule: A defect that is both is reported once, under correctness
must: Report it once, under correctness, with the higher of its two grades

rules.rule: Never flag mandated style forms (segmented strings) as defects
must: never propose a backtick raw string for it

rules.rule: Correctness findings graded by a named input
must: one you cannot tie to an input is at most Should-fix

rules.rule: Cross-boundary claims verified with LSP, not asserted
must: confirm it with the `LSP` tool

rules.rule: Report names every command the pass ran
must: one line naming every command this pass ran

rules.rule: Applying fixes requires the fixing.md test gate; rule edits need confirmation
must: applying findings requires the test gate in `references/fixing.md`
never write a rule without confirmation

rules.rule: Fan-out: one rule-id/tier list in every brief; every worker Blocker regraded at the merge
must: derive\ the\ `go:style`\ rule\-id\ and\ tier\ list\ once
regrade\ every\ correctness\ Blocker\ a\ worker\ reports\ against\ Output's\ rubric

rules.rule: A red baseline with uncommitted go.mod/go.sum is rerun on HEAD in a clean worktree before being called pre-existing
must: with\ any\ uncommitted\ change
rerun\ the\ baseline\ on\ `HEAD`\ in\ a\ clean\ worktree
apply\ the\ fixes\ in\ the\ working\ tree\ as\ usual,\ and\ run\ every\ later\ test\ gate\ in\ that\ worktree

rules.rule: Every worker-reported file:line is checked against the file at the merge
must: Check every worker's `file:line` against the file before it enters the report

rules.rule: The reported file count is read off the scope listing, never estimated
must: counted off the step-1 listing at\s+report time less any skipped, never estimated

rules.rule: Every Check run closes with Learn's scan of the session's feedback, writing only what the user picks; fan-out workers never run it
must: Close every completed Check run with Learn mode's scan
then\s+write only\s+what the user picks
a fan-out worker never runs it

rules.rule: A token that is no control, mode, or target is named as unrecognized and the run uses the defaults; an unresolvable target asks
must: say it was not recognized, name the ones that exist, and run with the defaults as if it were absent
A target that resolves to nothing: say so and ask — never guess what to work on
